Stack the ratio and energy distance into one long table for faceting.

Source: R/plot-composition-contrasts.R
stack_plot_statistics.Rd

Each input row (a posterior draw or a contrast summary) appears once per shown statistic, with the statistic's value in value and its panel label in statistic. The ratio panel always comes first.

Usage

stack_plot_statistics(source_data, show_energy, statistic_labels)

Arguments

source_data

Draws (Bayes) or contrast rows (permutation) carrying effectSize and, when show_energy is TRUE, energyDistance.

show_energy

Whether to include the energy distance panel.

statistic_labels

Named panel labels (ratio, energy).

Value

data.frame with value and a factor statistic.
